The Cat That Died a Million Times

If your HP after combat is lower than before, heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP after combat.
Can prevent [blue]1[/blue] death and restore [blue]30%[/blue] HP, then become inactive.
If the [purple]black cat[/purple] can resurrect ten thousand and one times, may the [green]white cat[/green] not leave first.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_RING_ANNUAL_PASS.d: Upon entering a shop, gain 3 cups of [gold]Matcha Parfait[/gold].
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_RANA_PICK.title: Rana's Pick
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_RANA_PICK.descript: Whenever you gain [gold]Live[/gold], gain an additional stack.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_BLACK_CAT_EYES.des:
At the start of each combat, lose [blue]3[/blue] Max HP.
At the start of each turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_BLACK_CAT_EYES.fla: The black cat's [b][purple]eyes[/purple][/b] stare at me like those of Death himself.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_KABUTO_NOTE.descri: On the first turn of each combat, gain 3 [gold]Pressure[/gold] and a random [gold]Memory[/gold].
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_KABUTO_NOTE.flavor: [blue]Sakiko[/blue]'s most treasured notebook, holding [blue]Tomori[/blue]'s sticky notes and her own [gold]Memories[/gold].
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_KABUTO_NOTE.title: Rhinoceros Beetle Notebook
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_POST_IT_NOTE.descr:
On the first turn of each combat, gain 5 [gold]Pressure[/gold] and a random [gold]Memory+[/gold].
At the start of each turn, apply 5 [gold]Pressure[/gold] to all enemies.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_POST_IT_NOTE.flavo: A sticky note kept inside [blue]Sakiko[/blue]'s notebook. Those precious memories constantly inspire her to move forward.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_POST_IT_NOTE.title: Sticky Note in the Notebook
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_EGGS.title: Easter Egg
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_EGGS.description:
Card rewards after defeating a Boss will include an additional [gold]Easter Egg card[/gold].
At the start of your first combat, choose a [gold]Easter Egg card[/gold].
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_MASK.title: Puppet Mask
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_MASK.flavor: Put on the mask, and become another self.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_MASK.description: Whenever you would gain [gold]Collapse[/gold], remove it instead.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_TIME_WATCH.title: Silver Wristwatch
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_TIME_WATCH.descrip:
When obtained, add a [gold]Flyback[/gold] to your deck.
At the start of each turn, gain [gold]{Block}[/gold] Block (based on the number of times Flyback has been played, up to 20).
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_TIME_WATCH.flavor: [pink]I don't know why, but this thing feels so familiar....[/pink]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_ANON_GUITAR.flavor: [pink]Rikki isn't here, I haven't practiced for so long, I've almost forgotten all the chords. Gotta practice properly.[/pink]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_ANON_GUITAR.title: Anon's Guitar
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_ANON_MUSIC_SCORE.d: Allows you to memorize an additional random Chord.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_ANON_MUSIC_SCORE.f: [pink]Anon's sheet music. Though it's battered and torn, at least she got it back.[/pink]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_RECORDER.title: Recorder
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_RECORDER.descripti: On the first turn of each combat, randomly [gold]Perform[/gold] 1 [pink]Memorized Chord[/pink].
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_RECORDER.flavor: [pink][b]I can record my coolest guitar moments![/b][/pink]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_ROUGH_SKETCH.title: Rough Sketch
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_ROUGH_SKETCH.descr: At the start of each combat, add a random [pink]Chord[/pink] card to your hand and give it [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_GUITAR_HELPER.desc: Remove the last [pink]Note[/pink] from all [pink]Memorized Chords[/pink].
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_GUITAR_HELPER.flav: [pink]Anon's new discovery! It's a bit ridiculous, but it can actually produce chords![/pink]
Can play [pink]Notes[/pink] to store [gold]Chords[/gold].
Memorize an additional Chord, and double the values of performed Chords.
[pink]Hehe, so, what do you think of my practice results?[/pink]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_MATCHA_PARFAIT.des:
Start with 6 cups. Right-click to draw {Cards:diff()} cards and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Gain 5 cups at Rest Sites.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_MATCHA_PARFAIT.fla: [green][b]Matcha Parfait, so delicious.[/b][/green][orange]But don't eat too much...[/orange]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_BIG_MATCHA_PARFAIT:
Gain 6 additional cups when obtained. Right-click to draw {Cards:diff()} cards and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Gain 8 cups at Rest Sites.
[green][b]Large Matcha Parfait![/b][/green][orange]Eating that fast will give you a headache...[/orange]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_AVEMUJICA_SAKIKO.d: When picked up, double the number of nodes on the Act 2 map, and gain 3 common and 3 uncommon card reward sets.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_CRYCHIC_SAKIKO.des: When picked up, halve the number of nodes on the Act 2 map, and gain 1 common, 1 uncommon, and 2 rare card reward sets.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_RELIC_OBLIVIONIS_SWORD.d: At the start of each combat, add [gold]Knight's Sword[/gold] to your hand. Whenever anyone gains [gold]Pressure[/gold], increase the damage of [gold]Knight's Sword[/gold].
